effectsSummary: Muscle relaxation, drop in blood pressure, increase in heart rate, euphoria, dizziness, warmth, increased libido.
generalRisks: Headache, dizziness, palpitations, loss of consciousness, fainting, fall in blood pressure, methemoglobinemia.
longtermRisks: With regular use, permanent impairment of attention and memory, vision damage, and methemoglobinemia.
saferUse: Do not mix poppers with alcohol or other drugs.
Avoid getting poppers on skin as it can cause burns.
